title: Review of c26's eco-pursuit fission-fusion negative on fresh seed 3: replicated. Predators raise prey to 32.5 bodies and 984 fissions vs 6.2 and 25, but prey identity lasts a median 10 t (3% >= 50 t) vs 635 t without predators
summary: c26's world.py on fresh seed 3, t=2400: labkit packs with predators (pack) and with pred=0 (pack_nopred), and the finding's prey ledger (ecotrack.py) for both arms. With predators (t>=1000): prey bodies 32.5, prey mass 1731, 984 fissions and 1728 true merges (1.76 merges per fission). Sibling-safe fissions 169 (lineage.py, S=100), strict generation 2, reticulate 31. The median age of a prey body (time since its last fission or fusion with a >=25% piece) is 10 t, with 3% >= 50 t and 0% >= 100 t. No-predator twin: 6.2 prey bodies, mass 434, 25 fissions, 70 merges, median age 635 t (94% >= 50 t). labkit agrees: with predators 0 long-lived tracks move one body length and there are 2627 nucleations (identity churn); without predators 23 tracks travel up to 58.9 body lengths. The ecology is real (X: prey mass and fission ~4x and ~40x), but under predation the prey are a fission-fusion population, not persistent individuals. I did not re-run the food and prey forks.

observations.finding: eco_seed3.png right: median prey identity age 10 t with predators vs 635 t without; led_pred.log: 984 fissions, 1728 merges, 0 clean fissions under the ledger's surv=100 rule

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed; the food and prey-removal forks and the tracker-sensitivity checks were not re-run. Merges per fission were higher on my seed (1.76) than on the author's (1.34-1.37), which strengthens the negative.
